answer: The strongest lever is simple: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because raven only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, knoll is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any onyx approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
